subject: Request: retroactive usage rebate & packaging alignment — Lighthouse Health
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Request: retroactive usage rebate & packaging alignment — Lighthouse Health

Team —

Quick summary: Lighthouse Health is asking for a retroactive rebate for Q2 usage after they exceeded the committed seat/compute floor during a one-week pilot ramp. They signed a starter SOW in May and their onboarding generated ~3x expected tokens for a short period due to a training campaign; they are asking for a goodwill rebate and a packaging tweak to move some monthly compute into a reserved bucket.

Why this is sensitive: customer is a mid-market health tech prospect with HIPAA considerations; they are negotiating to expand into a Dedicated deployment and have signaled potential to increase committed spend if we provide a bridge for the Q2 overage. Commercial wants a one-time rebate equal to 30% of the overage invoices (~$42k) plus a packaging credit to smooth into Dedicated onramp. Legal has redlines in the revised SOW (attached).

Asks:
- Marissa / Karthik: recommend one-off authorization path (VP/CFO threshold) for a $42k rebate + one-month reserved compute credit (~$10k equivalent).
- If approved, I will draft the customer-facing concession memo and update SOW for DocuSign.

Attachments: Lighthouse_SOW_v2.pdf, usage_report_Q2-Q3.csv, proposed_rebate_matrix.xlsx

Notes: Customer is sensitive to procurement timing; Evan Morris asked to close by EOD 9/16.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0121

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive usage rebate & packaging alignment — Lighthouse Health

Sofia / Aditya —

Thanks for the clear brief. A few quick questions before I escalate:
- Is the $42k figure audited? Karthik, can you confirm overage calculation (tokens by model tier, credits applied)?
- Is this purely goodwill or tied to an expansion commitment (e.g., 12-month Dedicated commit)?
- Are there any outstanding security/compliance items that could materially affect revenue recognition?

If the overage math and compliance are clean, I am willing to endorse a VP-level concession for up to $35k rebate with the balance requiring CFO sign-off. We need a short mutual action plan: customer commits to a Dedicated pilot and a 6-month baseline commit within 30 days. Please include that in the concession memo.

Looping in Karthik for the invoice reconciliation and Laura for formal CFO approval path.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive usage rebate & packaging alignment — Lighthouse Health

Marissa —

Thanks — answered inline and attached a short concession memo draft.
- $42,136.72 is reconciled in usage_report_Q2-Q3.csv; spikes are at UTC dates 2026-06-11 -> 2026-06-18 and match training window. Token mix concentrated on gpt-large; I included per-model breakdown.
- Customer is willing to sign a 6-month pilot Dedicated commit at an increased monthly floor (3x current) if we bridge the Q2 overage as a one-time make-good. The PM doc is in the SOW redlines.
- Compliance: they have completed our SOC2 questionnaire and we have a signed BAA; no outstanding blockers for Dedicated.

Proposed concession (from the draft):
- One-time rebate: 30% of overage ($12,640 immediate credit + apply $29,496 as a 'transitional credit' amortized over next 3 invoices) — net present value similar to $42k ask, but staggers recognition.
- Packaging: convert next 2 months of burst compute into reserved capacity at no extra charge (value est. $10k).
- Customer commitments: sign Dedicated pilot SOW (6 months) and provide a PO within 14 days.

If this structure is acceptable, please route to Laura for CFO approval on the remaining ~$6k above VP threshold (Marissa mentioned $35k).

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive usage rebate & packaging alignment — Lighthouse Health

Marissa / Laura —

Reconciled numbers attached. I ran the overage through our billing engine and confirm the $42,136.72 gross overage. The proposed commercial split in the concession memo maps to: $12,640 immediate credit; $29,496 transitional credit (amortize across invoices). The reserved-capacity credit estimate $9,800 — all within rounding to the ask.

Risk note: if we amortize the larger portion, revenue recognition pushes out across Q4 invoices; accounting prefers an explicit credit schedule on the SOW. Legal reviewed SOW redlines and requested the concession language be appended to Appendix B.

Approval recommendation: VP-level clearance for up to $35,000. Anything beyond requires Laura's signoff (CFO). If Laura approves the full structure, we will issue a concession memo and final SOW for DocuSign.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Financial Planning & Analysis
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retroactive usage rebate & packaging alignment — Lighthouse Health

Team —

Thanks for the thorough reconciliation and the proposed commercial mechanics. After reviewing the numbers and the customer commitment (6-month Dedicated pilot + PO in 14 days), I approve the full concession as proposed (one-time gross overage relief of $42,136.72 implemented via $12,640 immediate credit + $29,496 transitional credit amortized over next three invoices; reserved-capacity credit $9,800 applied to next invoice). Please ensure the following before issuing to customer:

1) Concession language appended to Appendix B of SOW and included in DocuSign packet.
2) PO and signed SOW must be received within 14 calendar days of concession execution; otherwise the credits are void.
3) Accounting will route the credit schedule to RevRec and Operations for processing — Karthik, please file the credit memo with GL code 5302.

Sofia / Aditya — proceed to send the concession memo and updated SOW for signature. Copy Legal on the DocuSign envelope.

Laura Bennett
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0199
